speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Good morning! How are you today?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: I am doing fine. How about you?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I am doing well! What are your plans for today?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: Complete surveys. You?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Oh, the same. Maybe spend some time outside. It looks nice. I am wondering, have you hear of the Save the Children charity?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: I have heard about it.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Oh that is great! I was on their website today and saw that they do a lot of great work to help kids out that are in need. They are always looking for donations. Are you willing to give even $0.10 of today's pay to help?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: Sure. That would be fine.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Can you confirm your donation in a number amount with the $ sign, just to avoid confusion?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: Is this okay?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Ooops, it looks like it did not show up, can you try again? Thank you! It will really help the kids in need!

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: $0.10-Can you see this?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes! Yes I can! That worked out. Have you heard about all of the storms/flooding in Hawaii?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: Yes. I have.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Well, then you will be interested to know that the STC website is already pledging to help these kids out! Have you ever been on their website?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: No. I have not.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I went on today and really learned a lot. Would you be surprised to find their home base is in CT?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: Yes. I would.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I was as well! I figured they would be in a more prominent area! So, just to confirm today I can count on you for $0.10?

speaker: A3E2NEZ6M1N1DT
text: That would be fine.
